content.short: A student-led organization focused on spreading blockchain education at UCI.
content.description: Blockchain at UCI furthers blockchain adoption by educating UCI students about real-world use cases and practical applications. The group regularly organizes events, hands-on workshops, and speaker sessions to demonstrate how blockchain technology can transform industries such as finance, healthcare, and supply chain management. Beyond education, it strives to build a thriving community of blockchain enthusiasts, developers, and entrepreneurs, and to connect members with industry leaders, mentors, and experts.
